exportLotStates
customMethods.script:
# implement your method here		
	''' 
 		Exports lot operation information and associated data such as asset and item links
 		 
 		Args: 
 			itemIds (list[int]): list of itemIds
 		Returns: 
 			exportInfo (dict) 
 			message (string): None if successful 
 		Updated: 
 			jz  10/14/25 created
 	'''
 	dbName = system.kanoa.config.getDBName('core') 
 	log = system.util.getLogger('kanoa_lot')
 	
	import java.lang
	
	lotStateIds = [row['lotStateId'] for row in self.view.custom.lotStates.selectedData]
 	log.info("exportLotStates() called with %s"%(lotStateIds)) 
 	exportInfo = {}
 	
 	try:
		lotStates = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.lot.getLotStates({'lotStateIdList': lotStateIds}))
		lotStateReasons = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.lot.getLotStateReasons({'lotStateIdList': lotStateIds}))
		lotStateReasonIds = list(set([row['lotStateReasonId'] for row in lotStateReasons]))
		assetLotStateReasons = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.lot.getAssetLotStateReasons({'lotStateReasonIdList': lotStateReasonIds}))
		
 		exportInfo['lotStates'] = lotStates
		exportInfo['lotStateReasons'] = lotStateReasons
		exportInfo['assetLotStateReasons'] = assetLotStateReasons
	 	
 		data = system.util.jsonDecode(str(system.util.jsonEncode(exportInfo)))
 		fileName = 'Lot States Export ({}).json'.format(system.date.format(system.date.now(), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'))
	
		document = system.util.jsonEncode({'exportType': 'lotStateInfo', 'data': system.util.jsonDecode(system.util.jsonEncode(data))})
		system.perspective.download(fileName, document)
		
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', {'message': 'Lot States exported'})
 		 
 	except java.lang.Exception, e:
 		log.error("exportLotStates() threw exception %s "%(e.cause))
 		system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', {'message': 'LotStates failed to export: %s'%e.cause})
	
	return

'''
		Imports all lot operation info including asset links, and item links (kanoaOPS)
		Args:
			exportInfo: dict
			userId: int
		Returns:
			success: bit
			msg: string
		Updated:
			10/14/25 JZ Created
	'''
	system.perspective.print('import lot states received')
	log = system.util.getLogger('kanoaLotImporter')
	userId = self.view.custom.security.userId
	exportInfo = payload['exportInfo']['data']
		
	import java.lang
	if not (exportInfo.has_key('lotStates') and exportInfo.has_key('lotStateReasons') and exportInfo.has_key('assetLotStateReasons')):
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', 'Import data does not have the expected fields')
		return
		
	roleId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('roleId', system.kanoa.security.getRoles({'roleName': 'Administrator'}))
	
	# add lot state data
	lotStatesAdded = 0
	lotStates = exportInfo['lotStates']
	lotStatesIdMap = {}
	for lotState in lotStates:
		lotStateInfo = dict(lotState)
		lotStateId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('lotStateId', system.kanoa.lot.getLotStates(({'lotStateName': lotStateInfo['lotStateName']})))
		if lotStateId:
			lotStatesIdMap[lotStateInfo['lotStateId']] = lotStateId
		else:
			newLotStateId, msg = system.kanoa.lot.addLotState(lotStateInfo, userId)
			lotStatesIdMap[lotStateInfo['lotStateId']] = newLotStateId
			lotStatesAdded += 1
	
	# Linking lot state reasons to lot states
	lotStateReasons = exportInfo['lotStateReasons']
	lotStateReasonsAdded = 0
	lotStateReasonsIdMap = {}
	for lsr in lotStateReasons:
		lsrInfo = dict(lsr)
		lotStateReasonId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('lotStateReasonId', system.kanoa.lot.getLotStateReasons({'lotStateReasonName': lsrInfo['lotStateReasonName'], 'lotStateId': lotStatesIdMap[lsrInfo['lotStateId']]}))
		if lotStateReasonId:
			lotStateReasonsIdMap[lsrInfo['lotStateReasonId']] = lotStateReasonId
		else:
			lsrInfo['lotStateId'] = lotStatesIdMap[lsrInfo['lotStateId']]
			newLSRId, msg = system.kanoa.lot.addLotStateReason(lsrInfo, userId)
			lotStateReasonsIdMap[lsrInfo['lotStateReasonId']] = newLSRId
			lotStateReasonsAdded += 1
	
	# Linking lot states/state reasons to assets
	assetLotStateReasons = exportInfo['assetLotStateReasons']
	reasonsLinked = 0
	for alsr in assetLotStateReasons:
		alsrInfo = dict(alsr)
		assetId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('assetId', system.kanoa.asset.getAssets({'assetPath': alsrInfo['assetPath']}))
		if assetId:
			alsrId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('lotStateReasonAssetLinkId', system.kanoa.lot.getAssetLotStateReasons({'assetId': assetId, 'lotStateReasonId': lotStateReasonsIdMap[alsrInfo['lotStateReasonId']]}))
			if not alsrId:
				system.kanoa.lot.linkAssetLotStates([assetId], [lotStateReasonsIdMap[alsrInfo['lotStateReasonId']]], userId)
				reasonsLinked += 1
	
	system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', payload={'message': '%s lot states, %s lot state reasons, %s asset links imported'%(lotStatesAdded, lotStateReasonsAdded, reasonsLinked)})
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.assetStates.data")
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.lotStateReasons.data")
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.lotStates.data")
	
	return {'passed': True, 'message': 'Lot States imported'}
